answer:
Confirmed: no network call accompanies deletion — purely local.

**Login** — `AuthService.login(username)` (`frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts:16`) is name-only, no password/backend call. It loads `localStorage['ai_dnd_user_<lowercase name>']` if it exists, or creates an empty `UserProfile` and persists it under `ai_dnd_user` (active) and `ai_dnd_user_<name>` (per-user copy). `isLoggedIn()` just checks `profile() !== null`; `authGuard` gates routes on this.

**Campaigns storage** — `UserProfile.campaigns` is an array of `CampaignSlot` objects held only in browser `localStorage` (keys `ai_dnd_user`, `ai_dnd_user_<name>`), each pointing to a Worker `sessionId`/`characterId`. Managed via `addCampaign`/`updateCampaign`/`removeCampaign` (`auth.service.ts:36,44,54`).

**Deleting a campaign slot** — `login.component.ts:57` calls `auth.removeCampaign(slotId)`, which only filters the slot out of `profile.campaigns` and re-persists to `localStorage` (`auth.service.ts:54-59`). It makes **no API call to the Worker**. The server-side character row in D1 `characters` (plus `character_inventory`, `adventure_log`) and the KV `session:<sessionId>` (7-day TTL) are **not deleted** — they remain orphaned until the session's natural TTL expiry; nothing in the UI references or cleans them up.
